licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (siam; qual scioccone, qual visetto and qual viso, where the libretto has quel; un altra and un impostura without apostrophes; si belli without an accent; dituccia; raro; giojello; Eh, un impostura, where the libretto has È un'impostura).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 61–63, the recitative between No. 6 and No. 7 (35 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). Secco recitative, printed without a key signature. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. In bar 18 a small dot after Don Giovanni's last note is read as a stray mark. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 69, from the median length (2:01) of five complete recordings, which give this recitative a track of its own (Fricsay 1958 1:53, Giulini 1959 1:34, Böhm 1977 2:01, Haitink 1984 2:02, Karajan 1985 2:06). Schirmer prints Recit. only.
